name: XTUSD
oneLiner: XTUSD is XT.com/XSC's MakerDAO-style vault dollar, minted against overcollateralized XTDao crypto vaults with limited public on-chain tooling for Pharos.
collateral: Overcollateralized XTDao vault collateral on XSC; issuer materials describe XT as the initial collateral asset with protocol support for additional collateral over time, but public live collateral composition remains hard to verify without XSC tooling.
pegMechanism: XTDao CDP: users mint XTUSD against overcollateralized vaults; risky vaults are auctioned to keep collateral above outstanding debt. Secondary market and account liquidity run through XT.com, and Pharos does not model a fiat cash redemption window.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: XT.COM's first-party announcement describes XTUSD as an XTDao vault system in which users mint against collateral and unsafe vaults are auctioned, establishing the CDP archetype.

oracleRisk.summary: XT.com documents XTUSD as an XTDao vault system with collateral auctions, but its first-party announcement does not identify the price oracle, feed source, or failover path used for vault collateral on XSC; current oracle wiring remains unverified.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: XTUSD resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

reserves.name: XT.com issuer-managed reserve assets
reserves.issuerOrObligor: XTDao vault collateral (initially the XT token) administered under XT.com/XSC

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
reserveReview.rationale: The first-party announcement describes XT as the initial XTDao collateral asset and says additional collateral may be supported later, but it is a 2022 launch announcement rather than a current reserve inventory. A 2026-07-20 re-review found no current collateral weights, custody evidence, or XSC-readable reserve state. The single issuer-managed envelope is retained with explicit v9 classification rather than invented constituent weights.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Pharos reserve row retained as an issuer-managed placeholder; the reviewed source establishes the historical XTDao design but not a current composition snapshot.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The sole issuer-managed reserve row has no current, independently verifiable collateral identity or weight.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The official source describes XTDao collateral mechanics but does not provide a current reserve composition or verifiable XSC state.

providers.name: XTDao vault contracts on XSC and XT.com issuer operations

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: XTUSD is described as an XTDao vault stablecoin on XSC under XT.com issuer operations, but no reviewed source names a custodian, account segregation, insolvency treatment, rehypothecation terms, or current vault-level collateral.

notices.title: Non-indexed issuance chain
notices.message: XTUSD primarily circulates on XSC, which is not EVM-indexed by Pharos. No on-chain contract is stored; supply and metadata are supplemented by external sources only.

notices.title: Redemption backstop not modeled
notices.message: XTUSD is tracked from market and issuer metadata, but Pharos has not source-reviewed a public holder redemption route for backstop scoring.

mintAuthority.summary: XTUSD is described by XT.com as an XTDao/MakerDAO-style vault stablecoin, with users minting against protocol collateral while DAO/protocol governance controls collateral parameters; the on-chain XSC admin remains unresolved.

controls.label: XTDao vault/protocol mint route
controls.capDescription: XTUSD minting is described as a MakerDAO-style vault route bounded by collateral and auctions; on-chain XSC cap/admin verification remains unresolved.
controls.evidence: XT.com's TAI-to-XTUSD announcement describes XTUSD's economic system as an XTDao smart-contract project based on MakerDAO, with vault collateral and auctions used to keep enough collateral against outstanding debt.

controls.label: XTDao collateral-parameter governance
controls.evidence: XT.com's announcement describes XTDao as the governance/protocol layer that can support multiple collateral assets over time, making the mint path user-collateralized but parameter-governed.

review.evidence: 2026-07-20 re-review: XSC (XT Smart Chain, chainId 520) DOES expose working public keyless RPC endpoints (https://datarpc1.xsc.pub and siblings, eth_chainId=0x208, latest block ~47.4M), superseding the earlier note that no public RPC exists. The XTUSD token contract 0x1a6131eaf7edd96afa10fc75b0d79dd814d19ed0 (CoinGecko-listed, XSC) is readable: 3,991-byte non-proxy bytecode (EIP-1967 impl slot zero), name() 'XT Stablecoin', symbol() 'XTUSD', decimals() 18, totalSupply() ~2,291,132.6. However the token exposes no enumerable administrative surface: owner(), masterMinter(), hasRole/getRoleMemberCount (AccessControl), and LayerZero endpoint() all revert, and a full-history eth_getLogs scan times out on the public nodes. The XTDao vault/mint contracts, cap authority, pause authority, and governance executor therefore remain unidentified: no contract addresses for the XTDao system are published in the reviewed issuer materials, and there is no public XSC block-explorer API to enumerate them. The mint-authority controls cannot be honestly resolved from verifiable evidence.
review.reviewer: SONG-1 mint-control evidence review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-8 (lead usdy-ondo-finance)
unresolvedQuestions: The XTDao vault/mint and governance contract addresses on XSC are not published in reviewed issuer materials and cannot be enumerated on-chain: the XTUSD token 0x1a6131eaf7edd96afa10fc75b0d79dd814d19ed0 exposes no owner/role/admin surface (owner(), hasRole(), masterMinter() all revert), full-history log scans time out on the public XSC RPCs, and no public XSC explorer API exists to trace deployer or internal transactions.

The reviewed first-party announcement identifies the historical XTDao design but does not identify the currently active mint contract, cap authority, pause authority, or upgrade authority; issuer disclosure of the XTDao system contracts or a functioning XSC explorer is required before the controls can be scored.
